description:
Rossell India incorporated in 1994, wns 7 Tea Estates in Assam and is engaged in the business of Cultivation, Manufacture and Sell of Bulk Tea. [1]

Key Points:
Company Overview: [1] [2] The company acquired its first tea estates, Dikom and Nokhroy, in Assam in 1994. Through subsequent acquisitions, including Dhoedaam Tea Estate in Jan'25, the Company has expanded annual production capacity from 2.7 Mn kg to ~7.5 Mn kg. It currently operates 7 tea estates spanning around 3,600 hectares, with ~20% of annual production exported to overseas markets.
